approvalAuthority.requestBasis: Repository owner explicitly authorized solving the exact production-signed runtime Google Sign-In and controlled-distribution-channel requirements as major step 2.

amendment.reason: The first governed install stopped after successful package replacement because the Android 16 notification-permission controller covered the expected login marker.
amendment.scopeChange: Permit privacy-minimizing denial of the app notification prompt and evidence-only finalization of the already completed exact package replacement without reinstalling.

explicitOauthAmendment.reason: After notification denial, the exact production app reached the approved-user home screen through a restored authentication session. That proves the approved-user gate but not a fresh production-certificate OAuth exchange.
explicitOauthAmendment.scopeChange: Permit in-app sign-out, including own-user fcmToken clearing, and require return to the Google sign-in screen before fresh OAuth proof.

postOauthDiagnosticAmendment.reason: The fresh production-certificate Google exchange reached Firebase Authentication, but the own-user profile hydration returned cloud_firestore/permission-denied before the approved home gate.
postOauthDiagnosticAmendment.scopeChange: Permit privacy-minimized read-only inspection of the selected identity's Firebase Auth verification flags, exactly its own users/{uid} document schema, the active Firestore Rules release and Firestore App Check enforcement mode.
